name: Restaurant Brands International Limited Partnership
summary: Restaurant Brands International Limited Partnership operates and franchises quick service restaurants in the United States and internationally. The company operates through six segments: Tim Hortons, Burger King, Popeyes Louisiana Kitchen, Firehouse Subs, International, and Restaurant Holdings.
